metaShifts.description: Many dominant offlaners and initiators (Axe, Pudge, Enigma, Centaur, Underlord, Clockwerk, Spirit Breaker, Dark Seer, Chaos Knight, Pangolier) received significant nerfs. This suggests a move away from highly tanky, disruptive frontliners who could dictate the pace of the mid-game, opening up the offlane pool and potentially favoring more damage-oriented or less tanky initiators.

Arcane Boots mana regen nerf, Meteor Hammer mana regen amplification nerf, and Wraith King's Reincarnation mana cost increase reinforce the trend from 7.36b where mana efficiency and sustain are critical. Heroes with low mana costs or innate mana regeneration are still at an advantage.

While 7.36b rebalanced physical damage, 7.36c specifically buffs Drow Ranger, Phantom Assassin, and Spectre, making them more viable. This continues to diversify the carry pool, moving away from a few dominant picks and encouraging a broader range of physical damage drafts.

Nerfs to heroes like Weaver, Bounty Hunter, Dark Willow, Hoodwink, and Storm Spirit (especially Static Remnant vision) indicate a slight curbing of early-mid game aggressive pick-offs and vision control. This might slow down the game's tempo slightly or make vision more contested.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: The increased Shadow Walk Break duration from 5s to 6s significantly benefits heroes who rely on break to disable passive abilities (e.g., Bristleback, Spectre, Phantom Assassin) or those who want extended invisibility for positioning and burst.
The mana cost reduction from 100 to 75 makes Meteor Hammer more spammable for heroes who build it for wave clear and siege, allowing for more sustained pressure on objectives.

While the cooldown increased, the health restored increased from 200 to 250, providing a small but valuable buff to survivability for blink initiators and spellcasters who rely on blinking into fights.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: The recipe cost increase from 200 to 400 (and total cost increase) directly impacts spell-burst heroes who relied on this item for an early power spike, making it harder to acquire quickly and delaying their impact. Khanda is also affected by this change, making it more expensive for its users as well.

Soul Rend no longer dealing damage if the silence is dispelled is a significant nerf against heroes with dispels (e.g., Manta Style, Eul's Scepter), reducing the reliability of Bloodthorn's burst damage.
The decreased Burn Radius from 700 to 650 hurts heroes who rely on it for farming, pushing, and teamfight aura, especially illusion heroes (e.g., Naga Siren, Phantom Lancer) and tanky aura carriers.
The Mana Regen decrease from 0.75 to 0.5 significantly impacts mana-hungry supports and offlaners who relied on it for sustained spellcasting and early game lane presence.

Carry.explanation: Multishot projectile speed buff makes her wave clear and teamfight damage more reliable, while the Level 20 Gust Self Movement Speed talent buff enhances her kiting and positioning.
Base damage increase and Immaterial starting evasion buff make her laning and early skirmishes stronger, helping her reach critical items faster and improving her survivability.
Desolate bonus damage and Level 15 talent buffs significantly increase her burst potential, especially against isolated targets, making her a more potent threat in skirmishes and teamfights.
While Wrath of God received a minor nerf, the overall physical carry rebalancing and nerfs to other strong offlaners might make him a more appealing pick as a hard-hitting carry.
Storm Surge damage buff makes him a stronger lane dominator and mid-game brawler, fitting the current tempo of the game and allowing him to apply more pressure.

Mid.explanation: Storm Surge damage buff makes him a stronger lane dominator and mid-game brawler, allowing him to secure last hits, harass opponents, and contribute more damage in early skirmishes.
Mastermind now also triggers if units under Invoker's control land the deny, which is a quality-of-life improvement that helps his laning and overall XP/gold gain, especially for Exort builds.
Sand Storm damage per second buff makes him a more potent mid-game threat, especially if played as a core, improving his farming speed and teamfight presence.
Lil' Shredder attack damage buff makes her a stronger lane presence and burst damage dealer, which can be highly effective in the mid lane for securing last hits and harassing opponents.

Offlane.explanation: Kraken Shell damage block rescaled to be slightly better at early levels (15/35/55/75 from 16/32/54/70), making him marginally tankier in the crucial laning phase.
Treant damage increased on each level makes his pushing and farming more efficient, allowing him to apply map pressure effectively and accelerate his item timings.

While his Scepter range was nerfed, the damage threshold buff on Borrowed Time and talent adjustments (Curse of Avernus slow, Borrowed Time Immolation DPS) make him a bit more resilient and impactful in fights.
Can be played offlane, and the general shift away from tanky offlaners might make his damage output and Warcry utility more valuable in the current meta.

SoftSupport.explanation: Sand Storm damage buff makes him a more impactful presence in teamfights and for securing objectives, especially with his mobility and area control as a position 4.
Crippling Fear now only starts costing mana per second with Aghanim's Scepter if the duration is extended, making his late-game lockdown more sustainable, though it's a niche buff.
Lil' Shredder attack damage buff improves her early game harass and burst potential, making her a stronger lane partner and more effective in early skirmishes.

HardSupport.explanation: Golem health adjustment is minor, but Warlock remains a strong teamfight support with good lane presence, and was not directly nerfed significantly, making him a stable and reliable pick.
Lil' Shredder attack damage buff improves her early game harass and burst potential, making her a stronger lane partner and more effective at securing range creeps or denying.

Carry.explanation: Geminate Attack damage and Shukuchi mana cost nerfs significantly reduce his early-mid game burst and farming efficiency, making him weaker in lane and slower to snowball.
Corpse Eater nerfs (less max health from creeps, more from heroes) make his farming slower and less reliable, forcing him into riskier hero kills to scale effectively.
Strength gain and Level 15 talent nerfs reduce his overall tankiness and illusion power, making him less effective as a hard carry who relies on raw stats and illusion damage.

Mid.explanation: Necromastery no longer increasing souls from other unit types and early Shadowraze bonus per stack nerfs significantly reduce his farming speed and early-game burst, making his laning phase much weaker and slowing his power spikes.
Galvanized charges decreased from 5 to 3 and Static Remnant vision radius decreased severely impact his early-mid game mobility, burst, and vision control, making him much harder to play effectively.
Refraction barrier per instance rescaled, Psionic Trap slow nerfs, and talent reductions make her less survivable and her traps less impactful, reducing her map control and pick-off potential.
Sleight of Fist bonus hero damage decreased reduces his burst potential, making him less effective in skirmishes and slowing his farming speed, impacting his ability to snowball.
Lightning Storm cast range decreased from 650 to 600 makes him more vulnerable when trying to harass or initiate, reducing his safety and effectiveness in lane and teamfights.

Offlane.explanation: One Man Army linger duration and Culling Blade talent nerfs reduce his survivability and late-game impact, making him less of a dominant frontliner and initiator.
Flesh Heap bonus Strength and Meat Shield duration nerfs significantly reduce his tankiness and sustain, making him easier to burst down and less effective in prolonged fights.
Base movement speed and Eidolon nerfs (health and damage) reduce his early game presence, farming speed, and overall impact, making him a less threatening initiator and pusher.
Base Health Regen and Rawhide Max Health Gain nerfs make him significantly weaker in lane and less tanky throughout the game, reducing his front-line presence and survivability.
Wall of Replica damage and Normal Punch max stun duration nerfs reduce his teamfight impact and pick-off potential, making him less effective at controlling fights and creating illusions.

SoftSupport.explanation: Magic Missile stun duration and damage nerfs, along with Wave of Terror armor reduction talent, significantly reduce her early game burst and control, making her less impactful in skirmishes.
Power Cogs cooldown and mana burn nerfs make him less spammable and less effective at controlling lanes and mana-draining enemies, reducing his overall disruption and early game pressure.
Track duration and damage amplification nerfs reduce his team's burst potential and gold advantage from kills, making him less effective as a snowballing support and vision provider.
Bramble Maze duration and Bedlam no longer castable on allies nerfs reduce her area control and burst potential, making her less versatile and impactful in fights and pick-offs.
Acorn Shot bonus attack range nerf reduces her harass potential and safety in lane, making her less effective as an aggressive ranged support and reducing her early game impact.

HardSupport.explanation: Nature's Guise Aghanim's Shard no longer increasing bonus movement speed reduces his mobility and ability to position for initiations or saves, making him less impactful in the mid-game rotations.
Borrowed Time Aghanim's Scepter range decreased from 1200 to 900 reduces his ability to save allies from a distance, making him less effective as a global or semi-global protector.
Nether Strike cooldown increased from 70/50/30s to 75/55/35s makes his ultimate less available for pick-offs and initiations, reducing his overall impact as a roaming support.
